suites.name: compact condition readers, initializers and comparisons
suites.method: original PC execution with explicit named-object initializer adapter
limitations: World global updates, reference lifetime, range computation, off-screen timer accumulation and alive-count population are external input contracts, not recovered by these readers.

Literal NumInSetAlive initializer admits 1..16 or myset; myset reads an unchecked byte index. Fixtures use a synthetic 256-byte backing region and do not assert the actual global count-table allocation size.
All scalar reader checks compare values at the float32 storage boundary used by the native SCP evaluator; signaling NaN payload behavior is excluded.
Eight symbolic comparison RHS occurrences and one malformed gotoUpdate occurrence retain separate source/loader gaps; their condition bodies were still exercised.

externalCommandContracts.scope: Finite scene fields and effective playback rates, valid acyclic member lists, explicit registry/world/reference bindings. Membership/target aliases preserve iteration order. No animation tick, rendering, collision world or reference lifetime implementation. Missing-name null dereference in LockedShut and malformed missing-operand source line are outside the contract.
limits: Finite scene fields and effective playback rates, valid acyclic member lists, explicit registry/world/reference bindings. Membership/target aliases preserve iteration order. No animation tick, rendering, collision world or reference lifetime implementation. Missing-name null dereference in LockedShut and malformed missing-operand source line are outside the contract.
SCP retains a previously found target when a later named lookup fails; GIT performs only one lookup for its last name token.
SCP stayshut forces reverse playback; GIT stayshut changes the stay flag without overriding the final FORWARD/BACKWARD choice.
AtStart is true for a nonnull gizmo whose output callback is unavailable (outputzero), while a null gizmo yieldsfalse.
Snap changes member frames without refreshing group state or list membership. Special-output reads may refresh the group state.
Native x87 seek tests include signed zero, subnormal and extreme finite values; exact float input bits are retained in replay fixtures.
Compilation does not establish C# runtime equivalence. Original-source comments/names and complete game behavior are not recovered by these contracts.
